subject: math
description: Compare cylinder and pyramid containers by calculating volume, converting capacity units, and justifying which design best fits a given need.
learningObjectives: Calculate and compare the volumes of cylindrical and pyramid-shaped containers
Convert cubic centimeters to milliliters and liters when interpreting capacity
Use dimensions, units, and context to decide which container fits a design requirement
Support a container choice with clear computations, labels, and a written justification
prerequisites: Use V = pi r squared h to find cylinder volume
Use V = one-third base area times height to find pyramid volume
Find the area of a square or rectangular base
Convert 1 cm^3 to 1 mL and 1000 mL to 1 L
